title: Imaginary Kitchen · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Imaginary Kitchen · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar cold snack or drink that needs no real ingredients. The lead mimes preparing it with imaginary tools, without speech. The others guess the intended snack or drink. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Imaginary Kitchen, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The others guess the intended snack or drink.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The others guess the intended snack or drink.
